name: Simple Ball (8 rounds)
pattern:

R2: INC x6
R3: (SC, INC) x6
R4: (SC 2, INC) x6
R5: SC 24
R6: (SC 2, DEC) x6
R7: (SC, DEC) x6
R8: DEC x6

R6: SC 30
R7: SC 30

R9: (SC 2, DEC) x6

name: Localized Bumps Test
comment: INC cluster at one side should produce a localized bulge, not a uniform ring
pattern:
R1: MR 6
R2: INC x6
R3: SC 12
R4: SC 5, INC 3, SC 4
R5: SC 5, INC 3, SC 7
R6: SC 18
R7: SC 18
R8: (SC, DEC) x6
R9: DEC x6

name: Localized Decrease Test
comment: DEC cluster at one side should produce a localized indentation
pattern:
R1: MR 6
R2: INC x6
R3: (SC, INC) x6
R4: SC 18
R5: SC 4, DEC 3, SC 5
R6: SC 12
R7: (SC, DEC) x4
R8: DEC x4
